mapper.select: WITH PaymentSum AS ( SELECT p.PAYMENT_NO, p.PAYMENT_AMOUNT, p.PAYMENT_DATE, m.EMPLOYER_NO FROM PAYMENT p JOIN PAYMENT_MEMBERSHIP pm ON p.PAYMENT_NO = pm.PAYMENT_NO JOIN MEMBERSHIP m ON pm.MEMBERSHIP_NO = m.MEMBERSHIP_NO GROUP BY p.PAYMENT_NO, p.PAYMENT_AMOUNT, p.PAYMENT_DATE, m.EMPLOYER_NO ), RankedEmployers AS ( SELECT e.EMPLOYER_NO, e.BUSINESS_NAME, e.BUSINESS_NICKNAME, SUM(ps.PAYMENT_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_PAYMENT, TO_CHAR(MAX(ps.PAYMENT_DATE), 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:mm:ss') AS LATEST_PAYMENT_DATE, RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY SUM(ps.PAYMENT_AMOUNT) DESC, MAX(ps.PAYMENT_DATE) DESC ) AS PAYMENT_RANK, CONCAT(BI.BUSINESS_IMG_PATH, BI.BUSINESS_IMG_RENAME) AS BUSINESS_IMG_URL FROM EMPLOYER e JOIN PaymentSum ps ON e.EMPLOYER_NO = ps.EMPLOYER_NO JOIN BUSINESS_IMG bi ON e.EMPLOYER_NO = bi.EMPLOYER_NO AND bi.BUSINESS_IMG_ORDER = 0 GROUP BY e.EMPLOYER_NO, e.BUSINESS_NAME, e.BUSINESS_NICKNAME, bi.BUSINESS_IMG_PATH, bi.BUSINESS_IMG_RENAME ) SELECT * FROM RankedEmployers WHERE PAYMENT_RANK <= 10
